items.title: Union Pacific (UNP) Stock Looks About Fairly Valued Today
items.summary: After a strong five year run, Union Pacific now appears closer to fairly valued. The intrinsic value estimate from a Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) model is only slightly below the current share price, and the broader checks point to a mixed picture rather than a clear bargain or a clear overvaluation. Union Pacific has delivered a total return of about 51% over the past five years, which puts more focus on whether today’s price already reflects that progress. For a railroad like Union Pacific,...

items.title: Union Pacific Sees Norfolk Southern Merger Closing by Late 2027 as STB Review Advances

items.title: Union Pacific Corp's Dividend Analysis
items.summary: Union Pacific Corp (NYSE:UNP) recently announced a total dividend of $1.42 per share, with the ex-dividend date set for 2026-08-31.  This includes a cash dividend of $1.42 per share, payable on 2026-09-30.  As investors look forward to this upcoming payment, the spotlight also shines on the company's dividend history, yield, and growth rates.
